ss_leo.instruct: Young American man, about 25, warm soft voice with a smile, gentle humor, natural and intimate, close to the microphone.
ss_leo.ref: So, this is my apartment. It is small, but it is mine.

ss_mia.instruct: Young American woman, about 24, bright witty voice, playful and teasing, natural, close to the microphone.
ss_mia.ref: Oh, come on. You call that music?

ss_oleo.instruct: American man about 75, warm soft slightly raspy voice, tender and loving, slow, close to the microphone.
ss_oleo.ref: We have been here a long, long time, my dear.

ss_omia.instruct: American woman about 74, warm gentle voice, playful and tender, a smile in the voice, close to the microphone.
ss_omia.ref: Oh, you old fool. I know.

lines.text: She lives right above me. We've never met.
Fifty years ago... you knocked first.
lines.emo: Tender, smiling, nostalgic, slow with a pause.
